name: Temporary Stay for the Purpose of Family Reunification

requirements.blocker_text: Requires being the spouse or common-law/life partner of a Croatian national, or of a third-country national holding permanent stay, temporary stay, long-term residence, or international protection in Croatia (partners: 3+ years' documented cohabitation, or shorter with a shared child).
Requires proof of the purpose of stay and sufficient means for self-support.
Requires being the minor biological or adopted child of a Croatian national, or of a third-country national holding permanent stay, temporary stay, long-term residence, or international protection.

requirement_groups.name: Parent or adoptive parent of a minor Croatian citizen/resident

requirements.blocker_text: Requires being the parent or adoptive parent of a minor who is a Croatian citizen, or who holds long-term residence or permanent stay.

evidence_required.document: Marriage certificate (spouse) or proof of cohabitation 3+ years (partner)
Birth certificate or adoption decision (child/parent grounds)

sources.title: Ministarstvo unutarnjih poslova Republike Hrvatske (mup.gov.hr) -- Temporary stay for the purpose of family reunification
Croatian Parliament -- Aliens Act (Official Gazette No. 133/2020, as amended 114/22, 151/22)

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Croatia's initial build. Sponsors holding only a seasonal work permit, or temporary stay for a purpose other than the listed grounds, cannot sponsor family reunification -- a real restriction, not encoded as its own requirement since it constrains who counts as a qualifying sponsor rather than the applicant. 'Exceptionally, any other relative' can be considered a close family member for special personal/humanitarian reasons per the source -- not built as its own group since it is a discretionary catch-all, not a defined test. HONEST GAP: no specific income/housing threshold figure was found in the fetched mup.gov.hr page for this route (unlike, e.g., Estonia's confirmed 'twice the subsistence level' figure) -- the general Aliens Act 'sufficient means' language is used instead of inventing a number. duration_length left as an explicit 'not specified' string rather than a guessed figure: not stated in the sources fetched in this pass. family_can_join set true: this route's own dependants (e.g. minor children of the sponsored spouse) can generally join through the same or a linked family-reunification filing, per the source's general framing of close family members.
